title: Role-play station
description: A simulated reviewer or the code's original author questions the learner; a separate grader marks the transcript.

title.description: A short title the learner sees.

after.description: Ids of earlier parts the learner should finish first.

brief.description: What the learner is told before the conversation.

script.description: What the simulated person knows, revealed only as the learner's questions call for it.

source.description: Where it comes from: a path and lines, a commit, a document or a public issue.

protectedTerms.description: Terms the person must not say before the learner does.

rubric.description: Each point the grader marks yes or no.

id.description: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter; unique in the lesson.
